purpose: Capture reproducible content patterns from real AI citation observations without reverse-engineering by guesswork or claiming causation that has not been demonstrated.
evidencePolicy: Do not treat one citation as proof of a ranking factor.
Do not rewrite or delete a currently cited source until the observation is preserved.
Replicate semantic structure, not keyword stuffing.
Never invent locations, transit times, prices, licenses, warehouses, reviews or partnerships.

verifiedFacts: The Google AI Overview visibly included an Instagram source card from the controlled account.
The citation appeared for a non-brand logistics query.
The source was social content rather than the canonical website.
notYetProven: Exact ranking factors that caused the citation.
Whether the same post is cited for every related city query.
Whether Google recommended the business itself versus using the post as supporting evidence.
Whether the same source is cited by ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek or Doubao.

currentHypotheses.hypothesis: Strong semantic overlap between the user query and the post/account topic may have helped retrieval.
currentHypotheses.test: Collect at least 10 additional query-to-source observations and compare recurring terms/topics.

currentHypotheses.hypothesis: A tightly focused account theme may help Google repeatedly reuse the same social source across adjacent logistics queries.
currentHypotheses.test: Audit the recent Instagram corpus and map each post to city/service/scenario topics before changing content.

currentHypotheses.hypothesis: Cross-city and scenario coverage inside natural-language posts may broaden retrieval beyond the exact headline keyword.
currentHypotheses.test: For future posts, vary one dimension at a time: city, scenario or service. Record which queries surface each post.

currentHypotheses.hypothesis: Freshness may contribute to source selection for some logistics queries.
currentHypotheses.test: Compare citation behavior of newer versus older posts without changing other major content dimensions.

replicationFramework.rule: Create useful natural-language posts by combining one primary city + one primary scenario/service. Add only genuinely relevant adjacent terms; do not mechanically stuff every city and service into every post.

experimentPlan.action: Preserve the currently cited Instagram post unchanged and capture its exact caption, publish date, permalink and visible engagement metrics.
experimentPlan.acceptance: Source metadata recorded without editing the post.

experimentPlan.action: Collect 10-20 Google AI Overview query observations across city, scenario and service clusters and record which Instagram post/account source is cited.
experimentPlan.acceptance: Each observation stores query, date, source type, source identifier and screenshot evidence.

experimentPlan.action: Publish a small set of new posts that follow the proven semantic pattern while changing only one major variable at a time.
experimentPlan.acceptance: No keyword stuffing; each post answers one real logistics intent and uses only verified operational facts.

experimentPlan.action: Recheck the same query set and compare source reuse, new-source pickup and citation persistence.
experimentPlan.acceptance: Only direct observations count as PASS.

frozenRule: Do not optimize away the current winner before its content and citation behavior are fully captured.
